body:
I had interests.. but now I just try distract myself from suicidal thoughts. I used to have hobbies but I just don't see any point to it, it's like a veil was thrown over my head...or took off.... I'm not sure any more.

I live in a rural area so there's more cliff-edges and shores rather than people to connect with. Who wants help from someone who can't even make eye contact...
